Type: half-moon metal bookcase
Use: displaying books and decor; living room, home office, entryway
Style: industrial, rustic, contemporary
Materials: black metal frame with bronze accents, fir wood shelves in a dark finish
Colors: black, dark grey-brown wood, bronze
Shape: wide semicircular frame, four wood shelves, X-shaped side braces, short round legs, open and airy, sculptural
Feel: bold, rugged, artistic
Goes with: brick, leather, dark wood, warm metals; industrial or rustic loft rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Half-Moon Industrial Rustic Bookcase, 54"W, Dark Fir Finish with Bronze Accents
product.description: The seamless marriage of cool black metal and warm dark-fir finished wood make this 4-shelf bookcase a versatile addition to any room. The half-moon frame design and sturdy metal supports hold your collection in style. 54”W x 13.75”D x 41.8”H Metal half-moon frame adds elegance and style to this 4-shelf bookcase A low height profile makes this bookcase ideal for displays against busy walls Simple assembly in less than 15 minutes Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
